scope: source-established applicability; actual KVM manager death/recovery is a separate required gate

primary_sources.finding: Reconnect from durable bootstrap to an existing shim; keep runtime parenthood in the shim. Dead/unresponsive shim cleanup is bounded and distinct from reconnection.
primary_sources.application: Retain the existing per-VM Rust supervisor and VMM. The new manager rotates only its control epoch, authenticates observed live generations and preserves unconfirmed reservations.
primary_sources.not_copied: GoldenHoop additionally checks root PID/start/executable, exact generation cgroup and socket identity. A failed response never establishes cleanup, and no runtime/protocol downgrade is used.

primary_sources.finding: An exited process may remain a zombie until its actual parent reaps it. A read-only PID/start-time mismatch is different from authority to signal or reap a replacement.
primary_sources.application: Require original manager identity absence before control replacement; preserve nonchild supervisor collection checks. Actual kill/zombie/reap unit coverage remains separate from KVM runtime acceptance.

local_design: hold the existing installation lease before reading/replacing control metadata
validate the prior exact configuration before writing config.json
bind cgroup/socket cleanup to recorded device/inode receipts; preserve foreign replacements and unrecorded existing objects
retain the prior manager epoch until the replacement is durably published
bounded independent supervisor observations; unconfirmed generations retain reservations and cannot replay unacknowledged creates
an adopted early supervisor without direct-child authority is not forcibly signalled before its original effect settles
authenticate supervisor generation membership for every control call, not merely during startup
existing supervisor preserves its actual VMM parenthood, console and expiry enforcement
actual runtime probe remains necessary for capability publication; manager Ready only publishes the control listener
not_accepted: earlier unacknowledged allocation and abandoned metadata recovery
snapshot restore/template/production placement and complete M4
power-loss durability inferred solely from SIGKILL tests
